disambiguation: This plugin reads local database files and writes transcripts; it is not a messaging client or a cloud synchronization service.
extras: Keep the vault private as transcripts contain personal messages.
problem: Users need a private, local method to archive and review WhatsApp conversations within their Obsidian vault without relying on cloud backups or APIs.
summary: Reads the local WhatsApp Desktop SQLite database to mirror conversations into individual Markdown transcript notes within the vault.
